responsibility: Defines the C-SKY backend’s RTL operand and pattern predicates used by instruction recognition, matching, and split/expand logic in the machine description. The predicates characterize load/store-multiple forms, legal immediates, compare operands, simple memory addresses, call addresses, floating-point constants and comparisons, push/pop addressing modes, and special parallel forms for multi-register push/pop, giving the .md files reusable target-specific recognizers beyond raw constraints.
